definitions.short: Calneh or Calno , a place in the Assyrian empire
definitions.full: H3641. Kalneh כַּלְנֵ֑ה (van d. H, so Norzi; Baer כַּלְנֶ֑ה ) proper name, of a location in Babylonia , Gen 10:10 (J), ᵐ5 Ξαλαννη ; Dl Pa 225 proposes identify. with Babylonian Kul-unu = Zirlab (conquered by Sargon in 710: COT 10:10 : Amos 6:2 ), but dubious, and site of Zirlab unknown. כַּלְנֶה Amos 6:2 , probably = כַּלְנוֺ Isa 10:9 proper name, of a location city (conquered by Assyria under Sargon ?) possibly = כַּנֶּה (q. v.) Ezek 27:23 , ᵐ5 omitted in Amos 6:2 , Ξαλαννη Isa 10:9 ; perhaps = Kullani (Wkl Geschichte. Babylonian 225) i.e. (Tomkins PSBA Jan. 1883, 61 ) Kullanhou, near Aleppo, conquered by Tiglath-Pileser III in 738 (COT ii, 195 ); or (Di) Kunulua (KG 217 KB i, 107 ), southeast of Antioch (compare Dr Amos 6:2 ).
definitions.rootNote: or כַּלְנֵה ; also כַּלְנוֹ ; of foreign derivation;
